faq.a: Abdulhadi is associated with the Arabic form عَبْدُ الْهَادِي, whose core sense is abdulhadi; servant of the guide.

faq.q: What is the origin of Abdulhadi?
faq.a: Abdulhadi is associated with Arabic. Abdulhadi is Arabic عَبْدُ الْهَادِي (ʿAbd al-Hādī), meaning 'servant of the Guide'.
Yes — the underlying form عَبْدُ الْهَادِي is Arabic.
Abdulhadi can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Abdulhadi should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. ʿAbd al-Hādī is a compound of two Quranic elements, not itself a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Abdulhadi mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Abdulhadi is rendered عبدالہادی and carries the sense عبدالہادی، ہادی کا بندہ.

faq.q: What does Abdulhadi mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Abdulhadi is rendered عبدالهادی and carries the sense عبدالهادی، بنده هادی.
A romanized syllable approximation is ab-dul-ha-di. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Abdulhadi, abdulhadi. Script forms are عبدالهادي, عبدالهادی, عبدالہادی, عَبْدُ الْهَادِي, अब्दुलहादी.
